title: NSM — C2 Hunt
description: Outbound behavior of the sensor: beaconing, rare clients, uploads, TLS anomalies and the C2 detections.

panels.title: Outbound connections

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS connections FROM nsm.zeek_conn WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND local_orig AND NOT local_resp

panels.description: Connections the sensor opened to the internet

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(id_resp_h) AS destinations FROM nsm.zeek_conn WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND local_orig AND NOT local_resp

panels.title: Uploaded

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(orig_bytes) AS uploaded FROM nsm.zeek_conn WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND local_orig AND NOT local_resp

panels.description: Payload bytes sent to the internet

panels.title: C2 findings now

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS findings FROM nsm.detection_hits WHERE run_at = (SELECT max(run_at) FROM nsm.detection_runs WHERE NOT backfill) AND detection_id IN ('DET-101', 'DET-102', 'DET-103', 'DET-104', 'DET-107', 'DET-108')

panels.description: Latest run of the C2 and exfiltration detections (DET-101/102/103/104/107/108)

panels.title: C2 and exfiltration findings (latest run)

targets.rawSql: SELECT h.detection_id AS detection, h.src AS source, h.dst AS destination, h.dst_port AS port, h.score AS finding_score, h.summary AS what, if(dv.latest_verdict = '', 'unreviewed', dv.latest_verdict) AS verdict FROM nsm.detection_hits AS h LEFT JOIN (SELECT subject, argMax(verdict, created_at) AS latest_verdict FROM nsm.verdicts WHERE source = 'detection' GROUP BY subject) AS dv ON dv.subject = h.hit_key WHERE h.run_at = (SELECT max(run_at) FROM nsm.detection_runs WHERE NOT backfill) AND h.detection_id IN ('DET-101', 'DET-102', 'DET-103', 'DET-104', 'DET-107', 'DET-108') ORDER BY finding_score DESC

panels.description: Allowlisted software (docs/tuning-log.md) is already filtered out; what remains needs a verdict

panels.title: Most regular outbound pairs

targets.rawSql: SELECT dst AS destination, port, sni, conns AS connections, round(med) AS median_interval_s, round(mad, 1) AS mad_s, round(mad / greatest(med, 1), 3) AS irregularity FROM (SELECT c.id_resp_h AS dst, c.id_resp_p AS port, anyIf(s.server_name, s.server_name != '') AS sni, count() AS conns, arrayPopFront(arrayDifference(arraySort(groupArray(toFloat64(c.ts))))) AS gaps, arrayReduce('median', gaps) AS med, arrayReduce('median', arrayMap(g -> abs(g - med), gaps)) AS mad FROM nsm.zeek_conn AS c LEFT JOIN (SELECT uid, server_name FROM nsm.zeek_ssl WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) AS s ON s.uid = c.uid WHERE $__timeFilter(c.ts) AND c.local_orig AND NOT c.local_resp GROUP BY dst, port HAVING conns >= 10) WHERE med >= 5 ORDER BY irregularity ASC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Hunting view of DET-101's idea: low MAD relative to the median interval means clockwork check-ins. Includes allowlisted software

panels.title: Top destinations by upload

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.id_resp_h AS destination, anyIf(s.server_name, s.server_name != '') AS sni, count() AS connections, sum(c.orig_bytes) AS bytes_up, sum(c.resp_bytes) AS bytes_down, round(sum(c.orig_bytes) / greatest(sum(c.orig_bytes) + sum(c.resp_bytes), 1), 2) AS upload_ratio FROM nsm.zeek_conn AS c LEFT JOIN (SELECT uid, server_name FROM nsm.zeek_ssl WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) AS s ON s.uid = c.uid WHERE $__timeFilter(c.ts) AND c.local_orig AND NOT c.local_resp GROUP BY destination ORDER BY bytes_up DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: upload_ratio near 1 = mostly sending (DET-107 looks for this at volume)

panels.title: Rarest TLS client fingerprints (JA4)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ja4, count() AS sessions, uniqExact(server_name) AS server_names, arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(3)(server_name), ', ') AS sample_sni, min(ts) AS first_seen FROM nsm.zeek_ssl WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ja4 != '' AND isIPAddressInRange(id_orig_h, '10.128.0.0/9') GROUP BY ja4 ORDER BY sessions ASC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Clients seen least often from the sensor; DET-103 compares against a longer baseline

panels.title: Outbound TLS without SNI

targets.rawSql: SELECT id_resp_h AS destination, id_resp_p AS port, count() AS sessions, anyIf(ja4, ja4 != '') AS client_ja4, max(ts) AS last_seen FROM nsm.zeek_ssl WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND server_name = '' AND isIPAddressInRange(id_orig_h, '10.128.0.0/9') GROUP BY destination, port ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Tools that connect to raw IPs skip SNI; so do sessions Zeek picked up mid-stream after a restart (no handshake seen)

panels.title: Protocols on unusual ports (outbound)

targets.rawSql: SELECT service AS detected, id_resp_p AS port, count() AS connections, uniqExact(id_resp_h) AS destinations FROM nsm.zeek_conn WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND local_orig AND NOT local_resp AND service != '' AND NOT ((service = 'ssl' AND id_resp_p = 443) OR (service = 'http' AND id_resp_p = 80) OR (service = 'dns' AND id_resp_p = 53) OR (service = 'ntp' AND id_resp_p = 123) OR (service = 'ssh' AND id_resp_p = 22)) GROUP BY detected, port ORDER BY connections DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Payload-identified protocol on a port it does not usually use (DET-108)

panels.title: Certificate validation problems

targets.rawSql: SELECT server_name AS sni, id_resp_h AS server, validation_status AS status, anyIf(issuer, issuer != '') AS cert_issuer, count() AS sessions FROM nsm.zeek_ssl WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND validation_status NOT IN ('', 'ok') GROUP BY sni, server, status ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: TLS 1.3 encrypts certificates, so most sessions have no validation result; TLS 1.2 ones do (DET-104)

panels.title: Outbound bytes

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, sum(orig_bytes) AS sent, sum(resp_bytes) AS received FROM nsm.zeek_conn WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND local_orig AND NOT local_resp GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Payload bytes to and from the internet
